description.value: T1-weighted datasets were bias-corrected, segmented, normalized to standard MNI space, accounted for different brain sizes by non-linear warping, and smoothed.

spans.text: Imaging data were bias-corrected, segmented into different tissue types, normalized to standard Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI, Quebec, Canada) space and accounted for different brain sizes by implementing non-linear warping. Subsequently, data were smoothed using a Gaussian kernel of 8 mm full width at half maximum.
